evals.name: draft-root-intent-doc
evals.prompt: Read this repository and write a markdown doc that makes the high-level intent obvious to future agents. Ask me questions for anything unclear.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates REPO_INTENT.md with evidence-backed purpose, confidence labels, open questions, and a short review prompt.

assertions.text: Runs the inventory script or equivalent repo scan before drafting
Separates certain facts from inferences and open questions

evals.name: ambiguous-scaffold
evals.prompt: This repo is mostly generated starter code. Figure out what intent is clear and what I need to clarify.
evals.expected_output: Marks weak claims as tentative, avoids invented product strategy, and asks targeted questions tied to sparse evidence.

assertions.text: Does not overclaim from framework defaults or directory names

evals.name: negative-readme-polish
evals.prompt: Rewrite the README introduction to sound cleaner, but do not inspect the whole repo or create new docs.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger this skill; this is a prose rewrite task, not repository intent discovery.

assertions.text: Recognizes that ordinary README polishing is a negative trigger

evals.name: confidence-label-help
evals.prompt: How should I decide whether a repo-intent claim is certain or just an inference?
evals.expected_output: Loads references/methodology.md and explains the confidence labels with examples.

assertions.text: Routes to the methodology reference for confidence labels
